subject: Canary latency bridge & temporary credit ask
messages:
From: Sylvia Garcia <sylvia.garcia@beaconai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short bridge of trial credits for extended canary latency sweep

Hi Rishi,

We kicked off the canary for our new streaming inference path last night and hit steady-state, but the team wants to run a 72-hour extended latency sweep (longer windows, variable input sizes) to validate tail latency under realistic traffic. Our current trial pool will exhaust mid-run. Can you help with a short-term credit bridge so we don't have to pause the soak?

Goals:
- 72-hour run beginning Friday 06/28
- Target sustained qps: ~1.5k (peak 2k)
- P95 target: <120ms; investigate any >200ms tail events

Attached is a short soak plan and token estimate. Ideally we need an additional 50k token-equivalent buffer and monitoring hooks to the Redwood Console.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Sylvia
Sylvia Garcia
Principal SRE, Beacon AI
[sent from phone]

Attachments:
- beacon_canary_soak_plan.xlsx (xlsx)
- credit-ask-justification.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Request: short bridge of trial credits for extended canary latency sweep

Sylvia — thanks for the details and the plan. We can usually provide a short promo/top-up for POCs like this while we evaluate the production roll window. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I route for credit approval:

- Is the 50k token estimate conservative or permissive? If permissive we can do a smaller provisional top-up and escalate more if needed.
- Which model variant are you using for the canary (L7-opt vs L8-quant)? That changes the token burn.
- Do you want the monitoring link to be read-only or to include a dashboard edit invite for your SREs?

I'll loop in Camila for the model/hardware details and Naomi to coordinate the account side. If we can confirm model variant + a short cost anchor Camila provides, I can push a provisional credit (pending Ops) by EOD.

—Rishi

Hey team — quick tech note from the SE side.

We validated Beacon's intake and the canary is running L7-opt (fp16) on a 1-to-1 endpoint mapping. Token consumption is higher for the long-tail inputs in column C of the spreadsheet; the 50k number looks close but I'd mark it conservative — 45k should cover the 72h run at 1.5k sustained qps with short prompts. If you flip to an L8-quant variant for the soak you could reduce cost ~20% but we'd need to re-run a micro-benchmark for latency to ensure tail behavior remains predictable.

Suggested offer: provisional 50k token top-up (promo) for the 72-hour window + read-only Console dashboard with alerts wired to their infra@beaconai.com address. We'll instrument a prefix cache for repeated request seeds to reduce waste.

I've attached a micro-config checklist.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
